posts.text: What if your to-do list stopped trying the moment you did? For my latest "stupid hackathon" project, I built MoodToDO, a task manager that embraces your mood. Using real-time facial recognition, it "helps" by deleting your entire task list if you look sad or stressed. Consider it productivity through emotional sabotage!
